terms.definition: Payment term indicating full invoice settlement is due within 14 calendar days of the invoice issue date.
Pricing model where the quoted line-item price already contains applicable tax; net amount equals Total / (1 + TaxRate), and tax equals Total - Net.
Pricing model where applicable tax is added on top of the discounted subtotal.
Grouping of unpaid open invoices by days past due date (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61+ days) to manage cash collection risk.
Estimated net project profit (Income minus direct Expenses) divided by total hours logged on the project.
Comparison between budgeted project hours/cost and real tracked hours/billable value to spot scope creep.
Mandatory human confirmation step before an AI tool or workflow writes, creates, or mutates business records in IndexedDB.
Optional configuration where a user supplies their own Gemini API key in volatile browser memory only, never saved to disk or backups.
Web Crypto encryption workflow deriving a 256-bit AES key from a user passphrase using SHA-256 and 210,000 PBKDF2 iterations for offline encrypted backups.
Pattern retrieving relevant local Knowledge Hub document chunks and attaching grounded citations to Copilot prompts without modifying model weights.
